description: This file defines a React component for a menu widget in the Mattermost web application, including static subcomponents, lifecycle methods, and DOM manipulation logic.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A React component representing a customizable dropdown menu with various static subcomponents and DOM manipulation for divider visibility.

methods.name: hideUnneededDividers
methods.description: Hides unnecessary divider elements in the menu DOM to improve visual clarity.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes divider hiding after component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that updates divider visibility after component updates.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that disconnects the DOM observer when the component unmounts.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Returns the bounding rectangle of the menu DOM element for positioning purposes.

methods.name: handleMenuClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the menu to prevent propagation when clicking on the menu background.
